1.web: Yahweh, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.
1.asv: O Jehovah, thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, Thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, shine forth.

2.web: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.
2.asv: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: Render to the proudtheir desert.

3.web: Yahweh, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?
3.asv: Jehovah, how long shall the wicked, How long shall the wicked triumph?

4.web: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.
4.asv: They prate, they speak arrogantly: All the workers of iniquity boast themselves.

5.web: They break your people in pieces, Yahweh, and afflict your heritage.
5.asv: They break in pieces thy people, O Jehovah, And afflict thy heritage.

6.web: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.
6.asv: They slay the widow and the sojourner, And murder the fatherless.

7.web: They say, “Yah will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”
7.asv: And they say, Jehovah will not see, Neither will the God of Jacob consider.

8.web: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?
8.asv: Consider, ye brutish among the people; And ye fools, when will ye be wise?

9.web: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?
9.asv: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? He that formed the eye, shall he not see?

10.web: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.
10.asv: He that chastiseth the nations, shall not he correct, Evenhe that teacheth man knowledge?

11.web: Yahweh knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
11.asv: Jehovah knoweth the thoughts of man, That they are vanity.

12.web: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law;
12.asv: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Jehovah, And teachest out of thy law;

13.web: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.
13.asv: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, Until the pit be digged for the wicked.

14.web: For Yahweh won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
14.asv: For Jehovah will not cast off his people, Neither will he forsake his inheritance.

15.web: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.
15.asv: For judgment shall return unto righteousness; And all the upright in heart shall follow it.

16.web: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?
16.asv: Who will rise up for me against the evil-doers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

17.web: Unless Yahweh had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.
17.asv: Unless Jehovah had been my help, My soul had soon dwelt in silence.

18.web: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.
18.asv: When I said, My foot slippeth; Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, held me up.

19.web: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
19.asv: In the multitude of my thoughts within me Thy comforts delight my soul.

20.web: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?
20.asv: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with thee, Which frameth mischief by statute?

21.web: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
21.asv: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, And condemn the innocent blood.

22.web: But Yahweh has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.
22.asv: But Jehovah hath been my high tower, And my God the rock of my refuge.

23.web: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. Yahweh, our God, will cut them off.
23.asv: And he hath brought upon them their own iniquity, And will cut them off in their own wickedness; Jehovah our God will cut them off.
